teaser.en: A slender, unassuming herb that Digo tell apart by its leaves and its small fruit capsules.
teaser.sw: Mmea mwembamba usio na makuu, ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na vibuyu vyake vidogo vya matunda.

summary.en: *Chibaruti* is a small herb of the acanthus family with small two-lipped flowers held between leafy bracts. Pakia records the name, but its meaning is unknown.
summary.sw: *Chibaruti* ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya *acanthus* wenye maua madogo ya midomo miwili yaliyoshikiliwa kati ya vigamba vya majani. Pakia inarekodi jina hili, lakini maana yake haijulikani.

about.en: *Hypoestes forskaolei* is an upright, often branching herb with soft, oval, opposite leaves. Its small flowers are white to pale pink-mauve, two-lipped, and held in clusters of narrow bracts at the leaf joints and stem tips. The fruit is a small capsule that splits open to throw out its seeds. Digo identify it from its leaves and fruits.
about.sw: *Hypoestes forskaolei* ni mmea uliosimama wima, mara nyingi wenye matawi, wenye majani laini ya umbo la yai yaliyo jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake madogo ni meupe hadi ya waridi-zambarau hafifu, yenye midomo miwili, na hushikiliwa katika vifungu vya vigamba vyembamba kwenye vifundo vya majani na ncha za mashina. Tunda lake ni kibuyu kidogo kinachopasuka na kurusha mbegu zake. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na matunda yake.

where.en: It is common at forest edges, in bushland, thickets and shady disturbed ground across Africa and Arabia.
where.sw: Ni wa kawaida pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani, kwenye vichaka vizito na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa yenye kivuli kote Afrika na Arabia.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chibaruti* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded. A relative, *Hypoestes aristata*, is the plant Digo call *jirimata futswe*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *chibaruti* na inaliorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Jamaa wake, *Hypoestes aristata*, ndio mmea ambao Wadigo huuita *jirimata futswe*.

reason.sw: Mmea mwingine mdogo wa familia ya *acanthus*
